containers.name: intangible-valuation
containers.notes: The node's own Next.js release (node server.js, not a standalone .next) copied into the image; uid 1001 is the deploy user the unit ran as. The unit's env file carries only PORT, and no secret is configured for it: no AUTH_SECRET and no STRIPE_* since the account surface was deleted on 2026-11-19, and no database of any kind since SurrealDB was removed the same day - the benchmark records are a bundled file. Built from the node's active slot (green) — the first attempt used blue and shipped an older release. Lean rebuild 2026-10-27: one COPY --chown layer and no .next/cache, 517 MB -> 378 MB. Rollout path is a manual pull-by-digest swap on ecs-01/02/03: no caller workflow can exist while apg-infra is private.

containers.name: intangible-valuation-api
containers.notes: Python WSGI app (api.index:handler) behind pylaunch, served from the node's own venv and work directory copied to the same paths so shebangs resolve. pylaunch binds 127.0.0.1 unless --host 0.0.0.0 is passed, which the entrypoint does. The reconciler and rollout probe HTTP on /api/health, which answers 503 when the route table is empty; the ALB target-group health check is declared in apg-infra and is not driven by this file. Built from the node's active slot (green) — the first attempt used blue and shipped an older release.

containers.name: intangible-valuation-mcp
containers.notes: Same image as the API, different entrypoint (api.mcp:handler) on 8060. The repository's own Dockerfile is the stdio MCP for the registry and is unrelated. Built from the node's active slot (green) — the first attempt used blue and shipped an older release.
